Choose Room related when local pattern l: Choose Room related when local pattern learning requires a room, or Global for intentional whole-home and context states.
Room status shows a warning only when a: Room status shows a warning only when a learned room-relevant state has no room and its scope is not explicitly Global. Assign a room or choose Global for intentional whole-home states.
The autonomy level limits what Freya may: The autonomy level limits what Freya may do. Learning and state permissions are configured separately.
All permissions default to off. Control: All permissions default to off. Control requires Observe, Learn, and Suggest and is used only by the controlled Action Executor. Locks and security states remain denied.
Both manual values are required for an o: Both manual values are required for an override
Candidate creation, withdrawal, accepted: Candidate creation, withdrawal, accepted status changes, and rejected commands are retained in a bounded in-memory audit log. Detailed pages are available through getActivity.
Complete action records are stored local: Complete action records are stored locally with correlation IDs. Explicit feedback is accepted only through submitFeedback from ioBroker Admin. An opposing Admin change inside the window is conservatively negative; ambiguous sources remain Unknown, unrelated changes are ignored, and no change becomes Neutral.
Controlled actions are deny-by-default. Level 3 still requires an eligible approved pattern, explicit Control permission, current conditions, confidence, writable metadata, and all safety checks. Level 0 is the installation default.
Execute the selected approved pattern on: Execute the selected approved pattern once after all current safety checks?
Approve this exact action proposal and e: Approve this exact action proposal and execute it once after all current safety checks?
Leave empty to use ioBroker system coord: Leave empty to use ioBroker system coordinates
LLMs are advisory only and cannot author: LLMs are advisory only and cannot authorize or execute actions. Rules Only is local and is the default. External analysis is sent only by an explicit Admin request and contains allow-listed aggregates without state IDs, room names, raw values, or persons. Use previewLlmDisclosure to inspect the exact payload first.
Mappings use semantic keys and may conta: Mappings use semantic keys and may contain several prioritized sources. No adapter-specific state IDs are hard-coded.
Ollama accepts loopback HTTP only; compa: Ollama accepts loopback HTTP only; compatible remote providers require HTTPS
Read-only learning for states with expli: Read-only learning for states with explicit Learn permission
Required for Ollama, OpenAI, and compati: Required for Ollama, OpenAI, and compatible providers; no model is silently substituted
Stored in protected and encrypted native: Stored in protected and encrypted native configuration; never logged or included in previews
Learn allows a state to contribute as a: Learn allows a state to contribute as a trigger or context source. Suggest applies only when the state is the proposed action target. Approval never grants Control permission; execution additionally requires level 3 and every current safety check.
Only required when this state may be the: Only required when this state may be the target of a proposed action; trigger and context sources need only Learn.
Suggestions require explicit Suggest per: Suggestions require explicit Suggest permission on both trigger and light. Approve/disable transitions are accepted only from ioBroker Admin and never grant Control permission. Execution additionally requires level 3 and every current safety check.
This policy is synchronized with Freya's: This policy is synchronized with Freya's Devices / States table. All permissions default to off; Control remains deny-by-default and requires the complete permission chain.
